instruction: I'd like you to open the Calendar tab in Thunderbird. Please make sure the Calendar interface is displayed within the application.

metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the Calendar tab in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks the accessibility tree for a tab named 'Calendar' within the Thunderbird tab list. This follows the same navigation pattern as the original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts accessibility tree for UI state verification
Metric correctly uses CSS selector to find Calendar tab in Thunderbird's tab list
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both that Calendar tab exists and is displayed
CSS selector is semantically correct: targets application[name=Thunderbird] > page-tab-list > page-tab[name="Calendar"]
No state accessibility issues: accessibility tree captures current UI state directly, no postconfig needed
Correct parameter handling: check_accessibility_tree receives rules parameter directly from get_rule
Logic will work correctly at runtime: standard accessibility tree navigation pattern
